title: Quick quiz: how water heating works
intro: Ten questions on the technology. Tap an answer to see why.

qs.q: How does a heat pump water heater heat water?
options: It moves heat from the surrounding air into the tank
It burns gas inside the tank
qs.why: It works like a refrigerator in reverse, pulling heat out of the air.

qs.q: When does a tankless water heater heat water?
options: Only when you turn on a tap
All day, to keep a tank hot
qs.why: It heats on demand, so it has no standby loss, but it needs enough power or gas flow.

qs.q: Compared with a regular electric tank, a heat pump water heater uses:
options: Far less electricity, often well under half
qs.why: A standard electric tank turns each unit of power into one unit of heat. A heat pump moves several.

qs.q: What does a heat pump water heater need around it?
options: Enough open air space to draw heat from
qs.why: In a tiny closet it can run short of heat. Ask the installer about room volume and airflow.

qs.q: What side effect does a heat pump water heater have on its room?
options: It cools and dries the air a little
It heats the room a lot
qs.why: It pulls heat from the air, which helps in a hot basement and can make a cold one chillier.

qs.q: What does a tank's 'first-hour rating' tell you?
options: How much hot water it can supply in a busy hour
How long it takes to heat the first time
qs.why: Match it to your family's busiest hour, such as the morning showers.

qs.q: Why do many installs use a mixing valve?
options: Keeps the tank hot enough to prevent bacteria while tap water stays safer
qs.why: A hotter tank holds more usable hot water, and the valve blends in cold water before it reaches the tap.

qs.q: What does a tank's anode rod do?
options: Corrodes in place of the tank walls
qs.why: It sacrifices itself to slow rust, and it needs replacing every few years.

qs.q: About how long does a water tank last?
qs.why: Ageing tanks can leak, so plan a replacement before it fails.

qs.q: Why do heat pump water heaters have an electric element mode?
options: For backup during heavy use or fast recovery
To act as the main heater
qs.why: Hybrid or electric mode helps when the household uses a lot of hot water at once.
